name: Reference campus (Abilene, TX): a public-information proxy, NOT the operator's actual equipment or design
use: Demonstration/reference only. Results describe what the models give for a campus with these publicly stated characteristics, not a claim about any operator's real design, protection settings or hardware.
selection_reason: Located in ERCOT (the Texas rule), in the West weather zone where ERCOT documented large-load fault and ride-through events; public information about its grid connection exists.

verified_from_primary_pages.note: Verified 2026-10-17 by reading the company/contractor pages directly (not independent confirmation).

campus.statement: 1.2 GW total power capacity; eight buildings; up to 50,000 NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 per building; phase 1 two buildings, >200 MW; phase 2 six buildings expected mid-2026; 1.2 GW grid interconnection
campus.source: Crusoe newsroom: expands Abilene AI campus to 1.2 GW

cooling.statement: Direct-to-chip liquid cooling, 'zero-water evaporation', closed water loop chilled by air-cooled chillers; ~1 million gallons of water per building

electrical.statement: Original 200 MW, 138 kV substation (2022-2024); 12.5-acre 1 GW, 345 kV greenfield substation with five main power transformers (three temporary units while permanent ones are procured; fully energized 2026-03-10; swap expected Oct 2026); work done 'in coordination with AEP'. Medium-voltage distribution to low-voltage transformers, switchgear, low-voltage UPS, RPPs as modular units

on_site_resources.statement: Natural-gas turbines for backup power; large-scale behind-the-meter battery storage and solar

not_verified_do_not_present.coordinates: exact location not confirmed (Crusoe names the Lancium Clean Campus in Abilene; county not explicitly stated); the KABI weather station is ~8 km from city centre only
not_verified_do_not_present.transmission_owner: contractor says work was 'in coordination with AEP'; ownership of the line is not stated
not_verified_do_not_present.onsite_gas_capacity_mw: ~360 MW appeared only in a secondary report (Cleanview); Crusoe gives no capacity
not_verified_do_not_present.load_ramp: 421 MW rising to 843 MW (Epoch AI) appeared in a secondary source only
not_found_publicly: rail droop or board undervoltage settings

scenario_inputs.voltage_dip_class: transmission (138/345 kV), stated by the contractor

kw_per_gpu_rack_level.basis: GB200 NVL72 racks ~120-132 kW per 72 GPUs (third-party guides)

rho_cross_job_phase_sharing.note: bounds plus illustrative midpoint; NOT probabilities; never collapsed to a default

systemic_event_rate_per_year.note: 95% interval bounds and posterior median from 2 documented events in 14.75 years; never collapsed to a default

capacitor_transfer.default: mid: 12 V stress group, no film-vs-electrolytic scaling (1.0); spread reported but not driven into headline results
